items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: we had Red Pepper... and we had a little trombone player, who played - Mouse Powell

ctx.x: ---so we could all have fun with the girls, you know and so on. But, that was a very good band; we had Red Pepper, who is a great trumpet player; and we had a little trombone player, who played - Mouse Powell---
